text.p: Iwerks Entertainment said it signed a definitive agreement to buy Showscan Entertainment in a deal valued at about $27.4 million.
The combined company will have about 160 ride simulation entertainment theaters and about $12.0 million a year in recurring film licensing revenue, the companies said.
According to terms of the transaction, each share of Showscan common stock to be converted into 0.85 of a share of Iwerks common stock.
Outstanding Showscan convertible preferred stock will also be exchanged for Iwerks common stock at the same ratio, the companies said.
Iwerks said it expects to issue about 5.62 million shares of its common stock in the merger.
Iwerks shares closed up 1/8 Monday at 4-7/8.
The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, the companies said.
The deal, which needs shareholder approval, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of this year, Iwerks said.
Roy Wright, Iwerks' chairman and chief executive, will be chairman and chief executive of the combined company, the companies said.
